name: Cloud
author: juansebas7ian
description: One panel for every cloud: overview, Google Drive (rclone mount), iCloud Drive (documents with their sync state, Apple's 30-day sign-in), Google Photos uploads and Dropbox. Mount switches, transfers and upload queues, storage, recent files.

barWidget.description: Left = panel · right = open ~/GoogleDrive. ↑N = files waiting to upload; red = a service failed or a sign-in is about to expire.
